title: Summability of a real geometric series
statement: In the field $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], let $t$ satisfy $0\le t<1$. Then $\sum_{n\ge0}t^n$ is summable, meaning that the net of its finite subsums converges in $\mathbf R$.
